topics.title: My Favourite Type of Music
topics.description: Talk about your favourite type of music.
topics.prompt: What kind of music do you like? Who is your favourite singer or band? When do you usually listen to music? Why do you like it?
topics.sample_answer: I really like pop music because it is interesting and relaxing. My favourite singer is a Vietnamese singer. I usually listen to music when I am studying or relaxing at home. Music helps me feel better after a long day. I also enjoy sharing my favourite songs with my friends.

topics.title: A Musical Instrument I Like
topics.description: Talk about a musical instrument you like or want to learn.
topics.prompt: What musical instrument do you like? Can you play it? Why would you like to learn it? What does it sound like?
topics.sample_answer: I like the guitar because it has a beautiful sound. I cannot play it very well yet, but I would like to learn. I think playing the guitar is fun and creative. I will practise regularly and learn some simple songs first.

topics.title: A Work of Art I Admire
topics.description: Talk about a painting, sculpture or other work of art you admire.
topics.prompt: What work of art do you admire? Who created it? What can you see in it? Why do you like it?
topics.sample_answer: One work of art I admire is a beautiful painting of a countryside scene. It shows green fields, small houses and a peaceful river. I like the colours because they make the painting look warm and relaxing. I think art is important because it helps people express their feelings and ideas.
